tasks.description:

**Acceptance Criteria:**

tasks.subject: Task 1: Sample-rate patch + host build harness
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `lib/` compiles on the host at 44.1 kHz, with the one upstream change carried as a patch rather than an edit.

**Files:**
- Create: `patches/0001-keyframerecorder-sample-rate.patch`
- Create: `scripts/apply_patches.sh`
- Create: `tests/host/Makefile`
- Create: `tests/host/test_lib_smoke.cpp`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `src/dsp/lib/` still byte-identical to upstream after the patch step
- [ ] Patch applies cleanly to `build/lib`
- [ ] `sizeof(Keyframe) == 12` asserted at compile time and runtime
- [ ] `KeyframeRecorder<1024>` initialises and processes a silent block without crashing

**Verify:** `make -C tests/host test`

**Steps:** apply_patches.sh copies src/dsp/lib to build/lib and applies patches/*.patch. Patch adds a `sample_rate` param to `KeyframeRecorder::Init` and replaces the hardcoded `detector.Init(48000.0f)` with `detector.Init(sample_rate)` — `Detector::Init` already accepts one. Smoke test heap-allocates the recorder (even a small ring blows the default stack).


tasks.subject: Task 2: Param mapping and modulation matrix
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A pure unit owning every taper and the pre-taper modulation matrix, fully tested without audio.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/dsp/capicola_params.h`, `src/dsp/capicola_params.cpp`
- Create: `tests/host/test_params.cpp`
- Modify: `tests/host/Makefile`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] All six primary and six secondary curves match the spec's mapping table
- [ ] `pitch` and `grain` round-trip norm to engineering to norm within 1e-4
- [ ] Threshold sends the mute sentinel `1.0e9` above norm 0.99
- [ ] Modulation applies BEFORE the taper: a fixed depth on `stretch` yields different engineering deltas at each end of the sweep
- [ ] Modulation clamps to 0..1 in norm space; zero depth is exact bypass

**Verify:** `make -C tests/host test`

**Steps:** TDD. Curves: stretch `(1-n)^2.5`; threshold `n<=0.9 ? n*(4/0.9) : 4+(n-0.9)*40`, `>0.99 -> 1.0e9`; quality linear 0.1 to 0.001 inverted; pitch detent then `exp2(s/12)`; smoothing `5e-5*(0.125/5e-5)^n`; fb_tone `2e-3*(0.9/2e-3)^n`; drive `0.5+3.5n`; fade ms to samples at 44100. `ModRouter::Apply` = `clamp01(norm + source*depth)`, called BEFORE the taper — the post-taper bug gives a constant delta and is otherwise inaudible.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/dsp/capicola_params.h", "src/dsp/capicola_params.cpp", "tests/host/test_params.cpp", "tests/host/Makefile"], "verifyCommand": "make -C tests/host test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["all 12 curves match the spec mapping table", "pitch and grain round-trip within 1e-4", "threshold >0.99 returns the 1.0e9 mute sentinel", "modulation is pre-taper: stretch deltas differ across the sweep", "modulation clamps to 0..1 in norm space", "zero depth is exact bypass"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Plugin wrapper
tasks.description:
**Goal:** A loadable `capicola.so` exposing `plugin_api_v2`, `chain_params`, `ui_hierarchy`, state persistence, and slice-on-note.

**Files:**
- Create: `src/dsp/capicola_plugin.cpp`, `tests/host/test_plugin.cpp`
- Modify: `tests/host/Makefile`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `move_plugin_init_v2` returns a v2 API with `api_version == 2`
- [ ] All 24 params round-trip through `set_param`/`get_param`
- [ ] `chain_params` parses as a JSON array with 24 entries
- [ ] `ui_hierarchy` parses as JSON with root, secondary and modulation levels
- [ ] `state` blob round-trips all 24 params
- [ ] `move_audio_fx_on_midi` note-on triggers a slice and survives a render
- [ ] `render_block` on int16 stereo produces finite output

**Verify:** `make -C tests/host test`

**Steps:** TDD. Primary params stored as NORMS (matrix modulates pre-taper); pitch and grain convert at the param boundary only. `PushAll()` applies mod then taper, in that order. Followers feed the matrix once per render_block (344 Hz). `state` is a fixed-arity 24-float blob refusing partial restores. `move_audio_fx_on_midi` is a separate extern "C" export the chain host dlsyms (ducker's path). chain_params and module.json inline metadata must agree — param_meta.mjs merges with chain_params winning. If `plugin_api_v2_t` field names differ, `src/dsp/plugin_api_v1.h` is the authority.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["src/dsp/capicola_plugin.cpp", "tests/host/test_plugin.cpp", "tests/host/Makefile"], "verifyCommand": "make -C tests/host test", "acceptanceCriteria": ["move_plugin_init_v2 returns api_version 2", "all 24 params round-trip set_param/get_param", "chain_params is a JSON array of 24 entries", "ui_hierarchy has root, secondary and modulation levels", "state blob round-trips all 24 params", "note-on triggers a slice without crashing", "render_block produces finite int16"], "modelTier": "standard"}
```

tasks.subject: Task 6: Build scripts and cross-compile
tasks.description:
**Goal:** `dist/capicola/capicola.so` built for ARM64 in Docker, with the packed-struct assertion holding under the cross-compiler.

**Files:**
- Create: `scripts/Dockerfile`, `scripts/build.sh`, `scripts/install.sh`

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] `./scripts/build.sh` produces `dist/capicola/capicola.so`
- [ ] `file` reports `ELF 64-bit LSB shared object, ARM aarch64`
- [ ] `dist/capicola/` contains `module.json` and `help.json`
- [ ] `dist/capicola-module.tar.gz` has a top-level `capicola/` dir
- [ ] `sizeof(Keyframe) == 12` holds under the cross-compiler
- [ ] `move_plugin_init_v2` and `move_audio_fx_on_midi` both exported

**Verify:** `./scripts/build.sh && file dist/capicola/capicola.so`

**Steps:** Dockerfile needs `g++-aarch64-linux-gnu`, `make`, `patch`. build.sh runs apply_patches.sh first so it compiles build/lib while src/dsp/lib stays pristine. `-std=c++17 -Ofast -march=armv8-a -mtune=cortex-a72`. Package with `cat` not `cp` (ExtFS deallocation under Docker). WATCH OUT: `-fvisibility=hidden` may hide the entry points — if dlsym can't find them, add `__attribute__((visibility("default")))` to both.

tasks.subject: Task 8: On-hardware verification
tasks.description:
**Goal:** Confirm on a real Move that the port behaves like capicola.

**USER-ORDERED GATE — NON-SKIPPABLE.** This task was requested by the user in the current conversation. It MUST NOT be closed by walking around it, by declaring it "verified inline", or by substituting a cheaper check. Close only after every item in `acceptanceCriteria` has been re-validated independently, with output captured.

**Files:**
- Modify: none expected; fixes land in the owning task's files

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- [ ] Module appears in the audio FX list and loads into a chain slot without error
- [ ] All knob pages reachable, every knob moves its parameter
- [ ] Drum loop at Stretch noon: splices audibly land on the hits, not at a fixed rate
- [ ] Stretch fully CW freezes: audio continues after the source stops
- [ ] A note into the slot forces an audible splice at Threshold max (mute)
- [ ] Raising a Modulation depth with the default Output Env source audibly self-modulates
- [ ] `mod_src_*` enum rows open the enum picker on a jog click
- [ ] Slot autosave restores all 24 params across a reload

**Verify:** Manual, on hardware, with the user present. Capture `ssh ableton@move.local "tail -50 /data/UserData/schwung/debug.log"` for any load error.

**Steps:** Build and install. ASK THE USER BEFORE ANY STEP THAT PRODUCES SOUND — say what will play and roughly how loud. Enable debug_log_on, confirm no dlopen/symbol error, then DISARM the log (leaving it on has itself caused dropouts). Walk the criteria in order. Feedback last, low volume, only after asking — the knob goes above 1.0 on purpose and is unstable there by design. Record deviations under "Known differences" in README; fix real bugs in the owning task.
